text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI tools can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. For example, you can type a few words into a program, and it will produce a painting or a short poem in seconds. However, there is an important difference between human and machine creativity. AI learns from existing works and mixes patterns together. Humans, on the other hand, create from personal feelings, experiences, and imagination. So while AI can support artists and writers, it cannot truly replace the unique spark of human creativity.
